Class ConfigSection<T extends IConfigSectionResult>

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.config.ConfigSection<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
AnimationsSection, CachingSection, GeneralSection, LimitsSection, LocaleSection, LoggingSection, ProtectionHooksSection, RedstoneSection, StructuresSection
public abstract class ConfigSection<T extends IConfigSectionResult> extends Object
Represents a section in the configuration.

This interface defines the contract for configuration sections, which are used to define specific parts of the configuration with their own initial transform actions.
